control_objective: Ensure accountability for PII processing is assigned and privacy roles are formally defined.
control_description: Privacy governance roles including the DPO or equivalent are documented in the PIMS, with defined responsibilities, escalation routes, and management reporting.
risk_addressed: Unassigned privacy accountability, leaving controls unowned and regulatory obligations unmonitored.
test_of_design: Inspect the PIMS scope statement and privacy role definitions for completeness and management approval.
test_of_effectiveness: Confirm role holders are current, and inspect evidence of privacy reporting to management during the period.
population_basis: All defined privacy roles within the PIMS scope.
sampling_basis: Annual non-key control: full population of defined roles, typically fewer than 10.
evidence_required: PIMS scope document, role descriptions, org chart, management review minutes.

control_objective: Ensure the lawful basis for processing PII is identified and documented for each purpose.
control_description: Each processing purpose recorded in the PIMS has an assessed and approved lawful basis, reviewed when the purpose changes.
risk_addressed: Processing PII without an identified lawful basis, invalidating the processing activity.
test_of_design: Inspect the purpose registration procedure and confirm lawful basis is a required field prior to approval.
test_of_effectiveness: Sample registered purposes and trace to approved lawful basis documentation predating processing.
population_basis: All processing purposes registered or amended in the PIMS during the period.
sampling_basis: Event-driven key control: 25 purposes, or full population if fewer.
evidence_required: PIMS purpose register, lawful basis assessments, approval records.

control_objective: Ensure consent is obtained, recorded, and capable of being demonstrated and withdrawn.
control_description: Consent records capture the PII principal identifier, purpose, timestamp, and notice version, and are retained for the period required to demonstrate compliance.
risk_addressed: Inability to demonstrate valid consent when challenged by a regulator or PII principal.
test_of_design: Review consent record structure and retention configuration against demonstrability requirements.
test_of_effectiveness: Sample consent records and verify all required attributes are captured and retrievable on demand.
population_basis: All consent records captured during the audit period.
sampling_basis: Continuous automated control: 25 records selected randomly across the period.
evidence_required: Consent record extracts, retention configuration, retrieval test evidence.

control_objective: Ensure privacy impact assessments are performed where processing presents risk to PII principals.
control_description: A PIA is triggered by defined risk criteria, completed with identified mitigations, and reviewed by the privacy function before processing commences.
risk_addressed: Unassessed privacy risk in new processing, resulting in unmitigated harm to PII principals.
test_of_design: Inspect PIA trigger criteria and confirm integration into the project initiation process.
test_of_effectiveness: Sample new processing activities and confirm PIA completion and mitigation sign-off prior to go-live.
population_basis: All new or changed processing activities in the period.
sampling_basis: Event-driven key control: 25 activities, or full population if fewer.
evidence_required: PIA trigger checklists, completed PIAs, mitigation trackers, go-live approvals.

control_objective: Maintain records of PII processing sufficient to demonstrate accountability.
control_description: A processing record is maintained covering purposes, categories, recipients, transfers, and retention, updated on change and reviewed annually.
risk_addressed: Incomplete processing records undermining dependent privacy controls and regulator response capability.
test_of_design: Inspect the processing record template for completeness against clause requirements and the update procedure.
test_of_effectiveness: Reconcile the processing record to the system inventory and investigate differences.
population_basis: All systems and business processes within the PIMS scope.
sampling_basis: Annual key control: full-population reconciliation; 10 entries traced to supporting documentation.
evidence_required: Processing record export, system inventory, reconciliation working paper, annual review sign-off.

control_objective: Ensure PII principals are provided with clear information about processing at or before collection.
control_description: Privacy information is published in plain language, version controlled, and reviewed against actual processing at least annually.
risk_addressed: Insufficient or inaccurate transparency information provided to PII principals.
test_of_design: Inspect the notice content standard and review procedure.
test_of_effectiveness: Agree published notice content to the processing record and inspect review sign-off.
population_basis: All published privacy notices in scope.
sampling_basis: Annual control: full population where fewer than 10 notices.
evidence_required: Published notices, version history, review sign-off, reconciliation to processing record.

control_objective: Ensure PII principal requests for access, correction, and erasure are fulfilled within defined timeframes.
control_description: A documented request handling process covers intake, identity verification, system coverage, fulfilment, and SLA monitoring.
risk_addressed: Failure to fulfil PII principal rights within committed or statutory timeframes.
test_of_design: Review the request handling procedure for SLA, verification, and coverage requirements.
test_of_effectiveness: Sample closed requests, recompute turnaround, and inspect verification and fulfilment evidence.
population_basis: All PII principal requests received during the period.
sampling_basis: Event-driven key control: 25 requests, or full population if fewer; include all SLA breaches.
evidence_required: Request log, SOP, verification records, fulfilment packs.

control_objective: Ensure collection of PII is limited to what is adequate, relevant, and necessary.
control_description: Data minimization is assessed at design time; collection forms and API schemas are reviewed to remove fields without a documented purpose.
risk_addressed: Excessive collection of PII beyond the stated purpose, increasing exposure and breaching minimization requirements.
test_of_design: Inspect the design review checklist for a minimization assessment step.
test_of_effectiveness: Sample collection points and confirm each captured field maps to a documented purpose in the processing record.
population_basis: All customer-facing collection forms and personal data ingestion interfaces.
sampling_basis: Event-driven non-key control: 10 collection points by volume.
evidence_required: Design review records, form and schema definitions, purpose mapping.

control_objective: Ensure PII is retained only as long as necessary and securely disposed of thereafter.
control_description: Retention periods are defined per PII category, enforced by scheduled deletion or anonymization, with disposal evidence retained.
risk_addressed: Retention of PII beyond necessity, increasing breach impact and breaching storage limitation requirements.
test_of_design: Inspect the retention schedule and disposal procedure for coverage of all PII categories.
test_of_effectiveness: Re-perform aged-record queries on sampled systems and agree disposal logs to the schedule.
population_basis: All systems in the PIMS inventory holding PII.
sampling_basis: Quarterly key control: 2 quarters per system across a minimum of 5 systems.
evidence_required: Retention schedule, purge job configuration, disposal logs, exception reports.

control_objective: Ensure PII is protected by appropriate technical measures including encryption and access restriction.
control_description: PII repositories enforce encryption at rest and in transit, and role-based access with periodic recertification.
risk_addressed: Unauthorized access to or disclosure of PII due to inadequate technical safeguards.
test_of_design: Inspect the encryption and access standards and their applicability to PII repositories.
test_of_effectiveness: Inspect encryption configuration for sampled repositories and re-perform an access recertification test.
population_basis: All repositories classified as holding PII.
sampling_basis: Semi-annual key control: 5 repositories per cycle, weighted to sensitivity.
evidence_required: Encryption configuration, access recertification records, key management evidence.

control_objective: Ensure PII breaches are identified, assessed, recorded, and escalated for notification.
control_description: Incident response procedures include PII breach triage criteria, a breach register, and defined escalation to the privacy function.
risk_addressed: PII breaches unrecognized or unescalated, resulting in missed notification obligations.
test_of_design: Inspect incident procedures for PII breach criteria and escalation to the privacy function.
test_of_effectiveness: Sample incidents involving PII and trace to breach register entries and escalation evidence.
population_basis: All incidents in the period tagged as involving PII.
sampling_basis: Event-driven key control: full population if fewer than 25; otherwise 25 incidents.
evidence_required: Incident tickets, breach assessments, breach register, escalation records.

control_objective: Ensure transfers of PII across jurisdictions are identified and subject to a documented basis.
control_description: Transfers are recorded with destination country, mechanism relied upon, and assessment of destination-country risk.
risk_addressed: Undocumented or unlawful cross-border transfers of PII.
test_of_design: Inspect the transfer register structure and assessment methodology.
test_of_effectiveness: Sample transfers and agree each to a documented mechanism and current assessment.
population_basis: All transfers on the register, reconciled to vendor and hosting records.
sampling_basis: Annual key control: 15 transfers, or full population if fewer.
evidence_required: Transfer register, contractual mechanisms, transfer assessments, hosting evidence.

control_objective: Ensure processor obligations are contractually established and monitored.
control_description: Processor contracts specify processing instructions, confidentiality, security, sub-processing, and return or deletion at termination; performance is monitored periodically.
risk_addressed: Processors operating outside documented instructions or without adequate safeguards.
test_of_design: Inspect the standard processor contract template against clause requirements.
test_of_effectiveness: Sample processors and confirm executed contracts with required terms and evidence of periodic monitoring.
population_basis: All processors in the vendor register handling PII.
sampling_basis: Event-driven key control: 25 processors, or full population if fewer.
evidence_required: Contract template, executed agreements, monitoring reports, assurance reports such as SOC 2 or ISO certificates.

control_objective: Ensure personnel handling PII receive privacy training appropriate to their role.
control_description: Privacy awareness training is assigned at onboarding and annually thereafter, with role-specific modules for high-risk functions and completion tracked to escalation.
risk_addressed: Human error and mishandling of PII arising from inadequate awareness, the most common root cause of privacy incidents.
test_of_design: Inspect training content, assignment rules, and the escalation procedure for non-completion.
test_of_effectiveness: Reconcile the training completion report to the active employee listing and investigate non-completers.
population_basis: All active employees and contractors with access to PII during the period, per HR listing.
sampling_basis: Annual key control: full-population completion reconciliation; sample 25 completions for supporting evidence.
evidence_required: Training content, LMS assignment configuration, completion report, HR active listing, escalation records.
